data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 围巾里的晚风
data.description: 街口的风有些冷，雪菜把围巾往上拢了拢，站在行道树旁等绿灯。
data.action: holding a scarf near her chin while waiting by the crossing
data.promptProse: Waiting beside a busy pedestrian crosswalk on a snowy winter evening, Setsuna buries her chin into the thick folds of her white cable-knit scarf, looking up with wide, sparkling eyes at the viewer. Blurred car taillights and shop windows create a dazzling sea of crimson and gold bokeh in the falling snow, framing her breathtaking, festive warmth.
